To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the new lentiCRISPr2 vector and genome-wide libraries have been improved over lentiCRISPtr1, with increased efficiency of gene knockout and a reduction in false-positive hits.
we developed improved vectors and genome-wide CRISPR libraries for CRISRP screening in mammalian cells.
the lentiCRISPERv2 vectors and genome-wide library have improved performance over the previous version.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a CRISPR/Cas9-based lentiviral system that is usually capable of efficiently delivering sgRNAs to the nucleus and expressing the Cas9 protein at a level that is usually compatible with the use of genome-wide CRISPR libraries.
the development of improved lentiviral vectors for the CRISPR screening and other applications.
the design of lentiviral vector-based genome-wide CRISPR screening tools for mammalian cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lentiCRISPr2.0 vectors have a number of improvements over lentiCRISPV1.
the CRISPR-Cas system is a powerful tool for genome editing.
the CRISPR/Cas9 technology is a very promising technology that is likely to be used in a wide variety of applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the lentiCRISPERv2 vector system can be used to generate high-titer lentiviruses for genome-wide CRISPR screening, with the potential for further improvement in titer by optimizing the sgRNA sequence and/or promoter.
the lentiCRISPr2.0 system has been optimized to increase viral transduction efficiency and reduce the risk of off-target cleavage.
the improved vectors, sgRNA library, and screening platform are now available to the research community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
lentiCRISPr2 can be used to screen for genes that are essential for cell proliferation, survival and growth in a variety of human cell lines, including cancer cell lines (Figs 1c,d and 2a).
the lentiCRISPr2 vectors are more effective than lentiCRISPtr1 vectors for genome-wide screening.
the sgRNA cassette is the limiting element in lentiCRISPr vector design, and that this element should be positioned as close to the 3 end of the viral RNA as possible.
